description: LibriSpeech test utterances already used by the project (named in committed outputs of the development repository). The TASLP-upgrade bitrate sweep excludes all of them.
method: git objects at the commit; files under results/ and results_paper/ with suffix .csv, .json, .jsonl, .md, .txt; utterance-ID pattern \b(\d{1,4})-(\d{1,6})-(\d{4})\b; speaker/chapter/utterance columns; (dataset, dataset_index) columns mapped through the sorted file listing; intersected with the LibriSpeech test file names
prior_study_selection_rule: rows with codec == 'wav' in results/<subset>_experiment_details.csv, mapped as paper/run_stage3.prior_study_utterances (500 per subset, seed 5305)
